signUpBody: The AletheiaFact.org platform is currently in beta. We invite journalists and fact-checkers to test our tools!
signUpFooter: Our goal is, after this stage, to open the system so that any user can add and review fact-checks. Follow us on social media and be part of this movement!
aboutUsTitle: Learn more about the AletheiaFact organization.
aboutUsBody: Aletheia is a movement and an open-source platform that offers free tools to empower any citizen in combating misinformation and strengthening democracy.
